items.q: The Persian word for a poem praising our Beloved Prophet ﷺ, used across Iran, Central Asia and South Asia.
The Persian word for a poem praising Allah, which usually comes before the na't in a long poem.
The great Persian poem of Mawlana Jalal al-Din Rumi ⁨رحمة الله عليه⁩, which opens with the lament of a reed flute.
The city in Anatolia where Mawlana Jalal al-Din Rumi ⁨رحمة الله عليه⁩ lived, taught and is buried.
The Persian poet of Shiraz who wrote the Gulistan and the Bustan.
The Persian poet of Herat, a Naqshbandi scholar, called "the seal of the poets".
The Persian poet of Nishapur who wrote "Mantiq al-Tayr" (The Conference of the Birds).
The Turkic Sufi poet of Yasi whose "Diwan-i Hikmat" was sung across Central Asia.
The city in Kazakhstan, once called Yasi, where Ahmad Yasawi's ⁨رحمة الله عليه⁩ great tomb stands.
items.src: UNESCO World Heritage Centre, Mausoleum of Khoja Ahmed Yasawi

items.q: The short sayings in verse of Ahmad Yasawi ⁨رحمة الله عليه⁩ are called this.
The poet of Herat who wrote in Chagatai Turkic and was a friend and student of Jami ⁨رحمة الله عليه⁩.
The city, now in Afghanistan, where Jami and Nava'i ⁨رحمة الله عليه⁩ما lived.
The Persian poet of Ghazni whose "Hadiqat al-Haqiqah" set the model for Sufi mathnawis.
The poet of Ganja whose five long poems are called the "Khamsa".
Many long Persian poems open with hamd, then na't, then a passage on this blessed night of our Beloved Prophet ﷺ.
The first of Nizami's ⁨رحمة الله عليه⁩ five poems, full of praise and counsel.
Rumi's ⁨رحمة الله عليه⁩ collection of ghazals is named after his spiritual companion.
The Persian poem of Jami ⁨رحمة الله عليه⁩, beginning "Nasima jaanib-e Batha guzar kun", asks this wind to carry greetings.
The Persian word for a poem in praise of a saint or of the Blessed Family ⁨(رِضْوَانُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِمْ)⁩.
The Sufi way of Jami ⁨رحمة الله عليه⁩ and of Baha' al-Din Naqshband ⁨رحمة الله عليه⁩ of Bukhara.
Mawlana Rumi ⁨رحمة الله عليه⁩ was born in this city, now in Afghanistan.
Mawlana Rumi ⁨رحمة الله عليه⁩ passed away in this year.
Jami ⁨رحمة الله عليه⁩ passed away in this year.
Nava'i ⁨رحمة الله عليه⁩ passed away in this year.
Ahmad Yasawi ⁨رحمة الله عليه⁩ passed away in this year, by the common report.
The ruler who ordered the great tomb of Ahmad Yasawi ⁨رحمة الله عليه⁩ in Turkistan.
items.src: UNESCO World Heritage Centre, Mausoleum of Khoja Ahmed Yasawi

items.q: Jami's ⁨رحمة الله عليه⁩ book of the lives of the Sufi saints.
Jami's ⁨رحمة الله عليه⁩ seven long poems are gathered under this name.
Nava'i ⁨رحمة الله عليه⁩ wrote his own "Khamsa" in this language.
The Persian poem form in rhyming couplets that gave Mawlana Rumi's ⁨رحمة الله عليه⁩ great poem its name.
Sa'di's ⁨رحمة الله عليه⁩ "Bustan" opens with hamd, then praise of our Beloved Prophet ﷺ; it was finished in this year.
Sana'i ⁨رحمة الله عليه⁩ passed away in about this year.
The Uzbek poet Sufi Allahyar ⁨رحمة الله عليه⁩ wrote this Turkic book of counsel and faith, read in Central Asian schools.
The father of Mawlana Rumi ⁨رحمة الله عليه⁩, a scholar called "Sultan al-'Ulama'".
The father of Rumi ⁨رحمة الله عليه⁩ wrote this book of sermons and visions.
The Mevlevi order of Rumi ⁨رحمة الله عليه⁩ was organised by his son.
The mathnawi of Jami ⁨رحمة الله عليه⁩ on the story of our master Yusuf ﵇ and Zulaykha, named after them in Persian.
items.a: "Yusuf u Zulaykha" (our master Yusuf ﵇ and Zulaykha)

items.q: Jami's ⁨رحمة الله عليه⁩ "Tuhfat al-Ahrar" follows the model of this poem by Nizami ⁨رحمة الله عليه⁩.
'Attar's ⁨رحمة الله عليه⁩ "Mantiq al-Tayr" tells of birds who go in search of this king.
The Mathnawi of Rumi ⁨رحمة الله عليه⁩ has this many books.
The Mathnawi of Rumi ⁨رحمة الله عليه⁩ was written down by this disciple.
Jami's ⁨رحمة الله عليه⁩ prose work modelled on Sa'di's Gulistan.
Nava'i's ⁨رحمة الله عليه⁩ book that argues Turkic is as rich as Persian for poetry.
Nava'i's ⁨رحمة الله عليه⁩ book of lives of saints, based on Jami's ⁨رحمة الله عليه⁩ Nafahat.
The successor of Ahmad Yasawi ⁨رحمة الله عليه⁩ in Turkistan, also a poet of hikmat.
'Attar's ⁨رحمة الله عليه⁩ prose book of the lives of the saints.
Sa'di's ⁨رحمة الله عليه⁩ "Gulistan" was finished in this year.
The famous Arabic quatrain on our Beloved Prophet ﷺ beginning "Balagha al-'ula bi-kamalihi" is credited to this poet.
items.a: Sa'di ⁨رحمة الله عليه⁩ (by the common attribution)
items.src: Standard attribution; not in all old copies of his works

items.q: 'Attar ⁨رحمة الله عليه⁩ is said to have been killed in this event in Nishapur.
items.src: Standard history; the report is not certain

items.q: Nizami ⁨رحمة الله عليه⁩ passed away in about this year.
Nizami's ⁨رحمة الله عليه⁩ "Makhzan al-Asrar" has four passages in praise of our Beloved Prophet ﷺ, including one on this event.
